doc: PROFILE.md §4.2: 'Multiple leaf nodes in a pipeline log an explicit error instead of silently using one.' The run continues with one leaf (exit 0). What is graded is that an error is logged at all: no document states a message for this path — §4.2 raises the requirement rather than a wording, and §4.3 leaves stderr free wherever no message is quoted — so the assertion is that stderr (or stdout) is not empty, and a tree that silently uses one leaf still fails. The pipeline genuinely has two leaves, so the condition §4.2 names is the one being exercised.
